description: Check whether domain names are free or registered using official RDAP. Pass full domains, or brand names plus TLDs. Returns available or registered, registrar, expiry date, age and nameservers. Max 12 domains per call.

details.description: Include registrar, dates and nameservers (default true).

tlds.description: TLDs to combine with names (default com, io, ai, dev).

name: check_domain_availability
title: Check domain availability (RDAP)
